n: Energy makers now go up to tier 25. Eleven new ones after Genesis Forge: World Smithy, Comet Foundry, Spiral Dynamo, Horizon Siphon, Prism Vault, Aether Orb, Halo Array, Shard Cathedral, Lens of Ages, Glitch Engine and Crown of Cells. Each makes 1,000× the one before, and the last three cost past 1e308, so they need Break Infinity
Tier 11 and up unlock the same way as tiers 1-10: own one of the tier before. You no longer need the late dimensions for them
Fabricator V and VI in the upgrade tree autobuy makers 15-19 and 20-25

Buy max in every prestige shop (Fragment perks, Singularity, Ascension, Void, the Infinity tree and Ultra). It buys the cheapest thing you can afford, again and again. It never buys the Omega Engine, so you can't end the game by accident
The 'Unknown signal' card says when you can afford the maker that reveals the next tier, and a note pops up when a new maker appears

Slower start: the first Rebirth needs 1e12 energy (was 1e10) and makers 1-10 make 40% of what they did, so the first run takes about 25-30 minutes of active play instead of about 11. Head Start now gives 100×5^level energy (was 100×10^level), and Lowered Threshold brings Rebirth down to 1e9
The 3D pet and crew renderer asks for the low-power GPU and no longer keeps a spare copy of every frame
